Settlements stay reversible for 36 epochs: a later audit that finds a settled answer was plagiarised or machine-spammed claws back the payout from the original recipient. That is 8 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
